newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle sales sales, profit growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Nestle sales sales, profit growth in 1997.

text.p: Nestle SA said it expects 1996 net profit growth to exceed growth in sales, which rose more than 7.1 percent to 60.5 billion Swiss francs.
It did not give more details.
It also said in a statement it expected sales volume to grow in 1997. "Barring adverse currency developments, the group should therefore register another increase in sales and profit," it said.
"The growth rate of the 1996 net profit is expected to exceed the growth rate of sales," it added.
Net profit figures and the dividend proposal for 1996 will be published after its board meets on March 26. The general meeting of shareholders will take place on June 5 in Lausanne.
